# The Vault Autohaus

> Car paint protection and detailing studio in Germiston and Bedfordview, Gauteng, South Africa: clear, matte and colour paint protection film (PPF), fitting of wings and other exterior parts, exterior and interior detailing, polishing and ceramic coating. By appointment only.

Website: https://www.thevaultsa.co.za/

## Prices (South African rand)
- Frontal PPF: R15 000, with a complimentary detail. Covers the complete front bumper (painted sections included), the entire bonnet, both front fenders and both painted side-mirror caps
- Full PPF: R35 000, with a complimentary detail
- Colour PPF: R40 000, with a complimentary detail (394 TPU colour films to choose from)
- Large SUVs can cost up to R3 000 extra for clear PPF and up to R5 000 extra for colour PPF
- Detail without a wrap: R4 000 to R6 000, depending on the car
- Polishing: basic gloss polish from R1 200, light correction from R2 000, medium correction from R3 500; heavy correction needs an inspection first
- Ceramic coating: from R5 000, depending on the car's size and the coating brand; it takes 1 to 3 days
- Not VAT registered, so no VAT is added to these prices
- Every car is inspected before booking, for a professional recommendation

## Detailing products
- Mainly Detail Ease; alternatives such as Meguiar's, depending on what the car needs

## Pages
- https://www.thevaultsa.co.za/ : services, prices, the colour vault (394 colour PPF films on a live car preview), booking steps, questions, contact
- https://www.thevaultsa.co.za/ppf.html : clear and matte paint protection film, frontal or full
- https://www.thevaultsa.co.za/colour-ppf.html : colour change in TPU colour PPF, with the colour vault
- https://www.thevaultsa.co.za/detailing.html : interior and exterior car detailing, the full checklist and add-ons
- https://www.thevaultsa.co.za/polishing-ceramic-coating.html : machine polishing (paint correction) and ceramic coating
